description: Shared conformance corpus pinning :name SQL parameter scanning and dialect placeholder rewriting between TypeScript (src/utils/sqlStatements.ts + queryParameters.ts) and Rust (src-tauri/src/services/named_parameters.rs).

cases.why: plain parameters and repeated occurrences in PostgreSQL
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = :status AND (owner = :owner OR backup = :owner)
cases.rewritten: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = $1 AND (owner = $2 OR backup = $3)

cases.why: array brackets in PostgreSQL allow parameters inside
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ANY(ARRAY[:first, :second])
cases.rewritten: SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ANY(ARRAY[$1, $2])

cases.why: PostgreSQL type casts, dollar quotes, nested block comments, and escape strings
strings, double-quoted identifiers, line comments, and block comments are skipped
cases.sql:
SELECT ':a', "col:b" FROM t -- :c
/* :d */ WHERE x = :e AND y = [col :f]
cases.rewritten:
SELECT ':a', "col:b" FROM t -- :c
/* :d */ WHERE x = ? AND y = [col :f]

cases.why: MySQL backticks, # comments, assignments, labels, and positional markers
MySQL non-whitespace -- is subtraction, not a comment
SQL Server bracketed identifiers and @P1 placeholders
Oracle q-quotes and trigger correlation names :new.col
cases.sql: SELECT q'[it's :a]', nq'(hi :b)', :new.updated_at, :c FROM dual WHERE d = :d
cases.rewritten: SELECT q'[it's :a]', nq'(hi :b)', :new.updated_at, :1 FROM dual WHERE d = :2

cases.why: DuckDB uses ? placeholders and supports array slices without false positives
cases.sql: SELECT arr[lo:hi], arr[1:n], :limit_val FROM t WHERE k = :key
cases.rewritten: SELECT arr[lo:hi], arr[1:n], ? FROM t WHERE k = ?

cases.why: ClickHouse typed parameter syntax {id:UInt64} is not a :name parameter
ClickHouse rejects actual :name parameters as unsupported dialect
